rules.statement: A conveyance by the executor of a share of the estate to a devisee, even if not in direct opposition to the terms of the will, cannot be impugned on the ground that the executor admitted an unmentioned beneficiary to equality with those named in the will after a long period.
rules.supporting_quote: "In regard to the devise to the testator's father it was submitted on the authority of Livera et al. v. Gunaratna 2[2 (1914) 17 N. L. R. 289.] a that although he predeceased the testator the fideicommissum did not lapse and that his interests were transmitted, on the death of the testator, to his heirs of whom undoubtedly Abdul Hameed was one."
